instruction: Change all text formatted in italics to bold within the recruitment script document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold formatting to all text that is currently italic in the document. The document contains at least 20 instances of italic text including placeholders like '[name]', '[physician/researcher/coordinator]', and instruction paragraphs. The evaluator checks that at least 15 italic instances are found and all are also bold formatted (i.e., both italic and bold).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies all italic text by checking font_style attribute
Getter properly verifies that all italic instances are also bold (both italic AND bold formatting)
Metric correctly implements the verification logic: checks minimum instance count (15) and all_bold_and_italic flag
Postconfig appropriately saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure fresh state
Expected value 'min_instances: 15' is semantically correct (document has 20+ italic instances, threshold allows reasonable variation)
Metric parameter handling is CORRECT: directly accesses expected.get('min_instances') since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
Edge cases properly handled: empty file, no italic text, partial bold formatting all return 0.0
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies ALL requirements (find italic text, verify all are bold, check minimum count)
ODT parsing logic is sound: uses odfpy library to read automatic styles and check font properties
